# ObservationManager must update after sim.reset() before first IMU data access

> **Current answer:** The original thread and PR #1809 processing involves: first executing sim.reset(), then scene.update(dt=physics_dt), followed by loading managers or reading IMU.data. Placing scene.update() before sim.reset() would access uninitialized articulation data. The version containing PR #1809 has this step included in ManagerBasedEnv and DirectRLEnv initialization; older versions can be reverted in the same order for retesting.

## Key terms

- ObservationManager (观测管理器)
- Scene update (场景更新)
- Inertial Measurement Unit (惯性测量单元)
- Initialization order (初始化顺序)

## Problem and symptoms

- Why is the ObservationManager reporting an error when trying to access IMU data before the update?
- ObservationManager accesses asset.data.lin_acc_b during term dimension preparation; IMU._dt is not set, resulting in a RuntimeError: The update function must be called before the data buffers are accessed the first time.

## Environment

- Original post: 84b2d2d8849e86752aa5a948d5f818d8430eec5a; Isaac Sim 4.2.0-rc.17; Ubuntu 20.04; RTX A6000; CUDA 11.8; ManagerBasedRLEnv/ANYmal-D; subsequent DirectRLEnv/ANYmal-C retesting.

## Priority diagnostics

- The initialization call chain was verified to ensure ObservationManager reads data before the first scene.update(); the relative order of scene.update() and sim.reset()/load_managers() was checked.

## Possible causes

- The environment initialization was not updated before extracting IMU.data, leading to IMU._dt and other scene buffers not being filled.

## Attempts

- The community manually added scene.update() during initialization; DirectRLEnv users encountered Articulation._data not found when placing scene.update() before sim.reset(). Swapping the order resolved the issue.

## Effective fixes

- Call self.scene.update(dt=self.physics_dt) after sim.reset() and before load_managers() or first sensor observation reading; or use the version containing PR #1809.

## Result

- DirectRLEnv users confirmed the corrected order; PR #1809 was merged into the main repository, and the issue was closed with merge commit 157c6b74.

## Limitations

- The PR #1809 checkbox was not selected; manual regression testing is still required for older branches.
